newsitem.title: USA: ESPNET SportsZone to offer single-day access.
newsitem.headline: ESPNET SportsZone to offer single-day access.

text.p: ESPNET SportsZone on Monday said it will offer single-day access to its premium online service, effective today.
The deal marks the first time that a subscription-based Internet site has made its premium content available on a single-day viewing basis.

In a statement, the online provider said it was teaming up with CyberCash Inc, a developer of software for secure financial transactions over the Internet, to provide single-day access to its premium online content for as little as $1 per day, using CyberCash's new electronic coin service CyberCoin.
The CyberCoin service enables cash payments ranging from 25 cents to $10 to be made for Internet transactions, with funds drawn from a consumer's existing bank account or credit card.
ESPN is owned by Walt Disney Co.
